integrity: The mathematical theorem and rank/row-flag proof are self-contained. Finite computations in verify.py support but do not establish the universal claim. No independent mathematical certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Canonical involutive solution attached to all strictly upper-triangular matrix radical braces over finite fields only; not arbitrary braces or all actions of a unitriangular group. The 2026 motivating preprint full text was unavailable, so independent priority verification remains necessary.
title: Complete orbit-size distribution for triangular radical-brace Yang–Baxter solutions
